blurb: Captain Mike Smith offers private fishing charters combining bottom fishing, trolling, and top water fishing targeting local species such as Fluke, Sea Bass, Striped Bass, Bluefish, Blackfish, Porgies, and False Albacore. The season runs from May 15th to October 31st. He also offers sunset boat cruises along the shores of several Connecticut towns.
